# Santorini — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where is Santorini?", "Greece"),
    ("What is notable about Santorini?", "Minoan eruption"),
    ("What is location?", "Greece"),
    ("What is key stat?", "c. 1600 BC"),
    ("What is notable fact?", "Minoan eruption"),
    ("What is note?", "May have inspired Atlantis"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
